column1: # One row per `<expr> / <arr>.length` site in the repo. The gate (--check) FAILS
# only on a site NOT listed here (status NEW), so every divide-by-length must be
# judged: can the divisor array be EMPTY at this site? If yes-and-unguarded → BUG
# (NaN/Infinity poisons the result). If guarded (early return, `len ?` ternary,
# loop-bound, or a constant non-empty literal) → SAFE with the reason.
#   STATUS = SAFE | BUG     (# or blank lines ignored)
#   key = the site's snippet with all whitespace removed (regenerate via
# Baseline triaged 2026-06-29 (loop iteration #6): all 32 live sites judged SAFE.
